tagline: An S3 API in front of a share you already have: top-level folders become buckets, and every file stays readable over SMB and NFS at the same time.
description: Puts an S3 API in front of a folder you already have. Point it at a share and every file in it is an S3 object, readable over S3 and over SMB or NFS at the same time - no import, no second copy, no migration. Unlike an object store such as Garage or SeaweedFS, this one brings no storage of its own: your array stays the storage, and the bucket is a directory.
author: Junker der Provinz

tips.before_install: Starts with ROOT_ACCESS_KEY as admin and ROOT_SECRET_KEY as casaos. Change them under Custom Installation before you store real data.

title: VersityGW
